name: Amir Albazi
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: An Iraqi-born flyweight raised in Sweden and based in London (17-3; age 33 per Wikipedia), listed at No. 8 by Wikipedia, who has lost two straight decisions, to Brandon Moreno (2024) and Kyoji Horiguchi (February 2026). He had heart surgery in 2023 and spine surgery in 2024 and has fought once a year or less since. Now with Great Britain Top Team (Wikipedia). This is a rematch: he knocked Alessandro Costa out in R3 in 2022.

how_they_fight.Striking: Patient, counter-minded and low-volume (about 2.9 significant strikes a minute at 37%). Out-landed in all three of his recent big fights in our data: 43-99 by Kara-France, 63-132 by Moreno, 16-73 by Horiguchi. Speed was the issue against Horiguchi (Cageside). He does have finishing power: dropped Costa twice, the second time with an uppercut.
how_they_fight.Grappling: His best route: nine submission wins (six in R1) and long control when he gets on top, such as 354 seconds against Costa and 370 against Kara-France. But recent takedown success is poor: 1 of 9 against Kara-France, 1 of 4 against Moreno, 0 of 7 against Horiguchi in our data. Cageside says Horiguchi kept escaping his clinches and body locks.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped; all three losses were decisions (Jose Torres 2019, Moreno, Horiguchi). Absorbs about 4.1 a minute and took visible damage from both Moreno (right eye compromised) and Horiguchi (bloodied).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Early finisher who now goes to decisions. Fourteen stoppage wins: nine in R1, four in R2, one in R3 (Costa, 2022). His last finish was that Costa fight. Since then: a disputed split over Kara-France (Wikipedia says 19 of 21 media outlets scored it for Kara-France) and two clear decision losses. Cageside notes he looked rusty early against Moreno and warmed up as it went on, and looked 'overwhelmed' by R3 against Horiguchi.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Smart, tactical, waits for openings. Layoffs (heart surgery complications, then a 15-month gap before Horiguchi) have cost him sharpness.

patterns: Submissions and top control when he gets the takedown

news.text: Booked in a rematch with Alessandro Costa on the Qatar prelims.
Lost a unanimous decision to Kyoji Horiguchi (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) after more than a year out.
Wikipedia notes a withdrawal from a planned fight with Tatsuro Taira in August 2025 with an injury.
